question: Which international event focused on climate change was held in Baku, Azerbaijan, in November 2024?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**COP29**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **COP29** refers to the 29th annual Conference of the Parties under the **United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC)**.
 
• The event is scheduled to take place in **Baku, Azerbaijan, in November 2024**.
 
• COP29 serves as a significant platform where world leaders, policymakers, and environmental experts come together to address climate
